# Reusable Docker Build, Publish & Attest

This workflow builds, optionally attests, and publishes an OCI image to JFrog Artifactory

## Usage

```yaml
jobs:
  build-docker-deploy:
    uses: aerospike/shared-workflows/.github/workflows/reusable_docker-build-deploy.yaml@<sha>
    with:
      jf-project: database
      image-name: test-image
      app-version: ${{ needs.extract-version.outputs.version }}
      context: .
      file: Dockerfile
      jf-build-name: test-build-container
```

## Inputs

### Required

- `app-version` (string, required): Version of the application (e.g., `1.2.3`)
- `image-name` (string, required): Docker image name (repository component, without registry). Used to construct the full image path (e.g., `test-image` becomes `artifact.aerospike.io/database-docker-dev-local/test-image:tag`)
- `jf-project` (string, required): JFrog project key

### Optional / defaults

- `app-name` (string, optional): Human-readable application name for OCI labels (defaults to `image-name`). Can differ from `image-name` for display purposes (e.g., `image-name="aerospike-server-enterprise"`, `app-name="Aerospike Server Enterprise"`)
- `attest` (boolean, default `true`): Generate SLSA build-provenance attestation
- `build-args-json` (string, default `{}`): JSON object of build-args passed to docker build (e.g., `{"VERSION":"7.0.0","BUILD_DATE":"2024-01-15T10:30:00Z","SOURCE_VERSION":"abc123"}`)
- `context` (string, default `.`): Docker build context directory
- `file` (string, default `Dockerfile`): Path to Dockerfile (relative to context)
- `jf-build-name` (string, optional): Build name for JFrog build-info (defaults to workflow name)
- `jf-registry` (string, optional): Full Docker registry URL including repository path (e.g., `artifact.aerospike.io/database-docker-dev-local`)
- `jf-registry-base` (string, default `artifact.aerospike.io`): Registry hostname (no repo path)
- `jf-url` (string, default `https://artifact.aerospike.io`): Base JFrog Artifactory URL
- `labels-json` (string, default `{}`): JSON object of image labels (e.g., `{"com.aerospike.version":"7.0.0","com.aerospike.release":"stable","maintainer":"Aerospike"}`)
- `oidc-audience` (string, default `aerospike/testing`): OIDC audience value for token
- `oidc-provider-name` (string, default `gh-dev-test`): JFrog OIDC provider name
- `platforms` (string, default `linux/amd64,linux/arm64`): Comma-separated target platforms for buildx
- `provenance` (string, default `mode=max`): BuildKit provenance setting (`''`, `'false'`, or `'mode=max'`)
- `push` (boolean, default `true`): Whether to push the image
- `repo-scope` (string, default `-docker-dev-local`): Repository suffix appended to jf-project (e.g., `-docker-preview-public-local`)
- `sbom` (boolean, default `true`): Enable SBOM generation (pass-through to docker/build-push-action)
- `versions-override` (string, optional): Override the tags generated by the workflow (other than the immutable tag which is always generated). Format: comma separated list of versions (e.g., `"tag1,tag2,tag3"`). If not provided, the tags generated (for app version `3.2.1`) would be `3.2.1_20251202T021054Z, 3.2.1, 3, latest`. Setting this value to `"dev"` would cause the tags to be `3.2.1_20251202T021054Z, dev`. Only the tag portion is settable in this way. App name, repository scope, and app version are calculated.

## Outputs

- `digest`: Image manifest digest
- `image-ref`: Primary tag with `@digest`
- `tags`: Comma separated list of tags used
- `immutable-tag`: Immutable tag (registry/image:version_timestamp)

## Tag Generation

The workflow automatically generates tags based on the `app-version` input:

1. **Immutable tag** (always generated): `{registry}/{image-name}:{app-version}_{timestamp}` (e.g., `artifact.aerospike.io/database-docker-dev-local/test-image:7.0.0_20251202T021054Z`)
2. **Default tags** (when `versions-override` is not provided):
   - Version tag: `{registry}/{image-name}:{app-version}` (e.g., `artifact.aerospike.io/database-docker-dev-local/test-image:7.0.0`)
   - Major version tag: `{registry}/{image-name}:{major}` (e.g., `artifact.aerospike.io/database-docker-dev-local/test-image:7`)
   - Latest tag: `{registry}/{image-name}:latest` (e.g., `artifact.aerospike.io/database-docker-dev-local/test-image:latest`)
3. **Custom tags** (when `versions-override` is provided): Only the immutable tag plus the override tags are generated (e.g., with `versions-override: "dev"`, for app version `7.0.0`, the tag portions would be `7.0.0_20251202T021054Z, dev`).

The registry is automatically constructed from `jf-registry` (if provided) or `{jf-registry-base}/{jf-project}{repo-scope}`.

## Notes

- The workflow automatically handles `v` prefix in version strings (e.g., `v1.2.3` becomes `1.2.3`)
- OCI labels are automatically generated with image metadata (title, version, created, revision, source, url)
- User-provided labels (via `labels-json`) override OCI labels when keys conflict
- For Artifactory, the registry path includes the repository (e.g., `artifact.aerospike.io/database-docker-dev-local`)
